check_connection.title: Check connection
check_connection.description: Confirm the API key works by listing templates through the v1 list-templates endpoint, the catalogue verification endpoint. Returns status and the templates; an error status means the key is wrong.

get_account_information.title: Get account information
get_account_information.description: Get the account's subscription and usage: plan, billing period, subscription status, API quota with calls used and remaining, and template quota and count. Use it before a large batch to check remaining credits.

output.description: status, subscription_product, subscription_status, subscription_interval, subscription_current_period_start/end, api_quota, api_used, api_remaining, template_quota, template_count, template_remaining.

list_templates.title: List templates
list_templates.description: List the account's PDF and image templates with their ids, names, format and group, filtered by format, id or group. Set with_layer_info to 1 to see an image template's layer names, which create_image overrides by name.

format.description: Only PDF or only image (JPEG) templates.

template_id.description: Only the template with this id.

with_layer_info.description: 1 to include layer information for image templates (the object names create_image overrides); 0 (default) not.

output.description: The templates: template_id, name, format, created_at, updated_at, group_name and, when asked, layers.

get_template.title: Get a PDF template
get_template.description: Get one PDF template's HTML body, CSS and settings (paper size, header, footer, margins). Pair with update_template to edit a template. Experimental endpoint per APITemplate.io.

template_id.description: The template id, from list_templates or the web console (Manage Templates).

output.description: status, template_id, body (HTML), css and settings.

update_template.title: Update a PDF template
update_template.description: Replace a PDF template's HTML body, CSS and/or header and footer settings. Only the fields you pass are sent; fetch the current template first with get_template. Experimental endpoint per APITemplate.io.

template_id.description: The template id, from list_templates or the web console (Manage Templates).

body.description: The new HTML body (Jinja2 placeholders allowed).

settings.description: Template settings: custom_header and custom_footer as HTML.

list_generated_objects.title: List generated objects
list_generated_objects.description: List the PDFs and images the account has generated, newest first, with their transaction_ref, template, download URL, meta reference and status. Filter by template, type (PDF, JPEG, MERGE) or a single transaction_ref.

template_id.description: Only objects generated from this template.

transaction_ref.description: Only the object with this transaction reference.

output.description: The generated objects: transaction_ref, description, source, meta, transaction_type, primary_url, secondary_url, deleted_at, deletion_status, ip_address, created_at.

create_pdf.title: Create a PDF from a template
create_pdf.description: Generate a PDF from a saved PDF template and JSON data that fills its Jinja2 placeholders (e.g. invoice_number, items). Returns the download_url. Use create_pdf_from_html or create_pdf_from_markdown when there is no saved template, and create_image for image templates.

template_id.description: The template id, from list_templates or the web console (Manage Templates).

output_html.description: 1 to also return the rendered HTML as html_url; 0 (default) not.

load_data_from.description: A URL to load the JSON data from instead of the request body; when set, data in the body is ignored.

extract_link.description: 1 to extract links from the HTML content; 0 (default) not.

expiration.description: Minutes to keep the generated file on the CDN: 0 (default) stores it permanently, 1-10080 (7 days) expires it.

output_format.description: Output format: pdf (default), html, png or jpeg. The response download_url points at the file.

filename.description: Custom file name ending in .pdf. Defaults to a UUID.

cloud_storage.description: 1 (default) uploads the file to APITemplate.io's CDN; set 0 when a Post Action uploads it to your own storage.

generation_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before generation starts, e.g. to let scripts or fonts load.

image_resample_res.description: Downsample embedded images to this DPI to shrink the PDF, e.g. 72, 96, 150, 300 or 600.

resize_images.description: 1 to resize JPEG/PNG images before embedding them (use resize_max_width/height and resize_format); 0 (default) not.

resize_max_width.description: Maximum image width in pixels when resize_images is 1 (default 1000).

resize_max_height.description: Maximum image height in pixels when resize_images is 1 (default 1000).

postaction_s3_filekey.description: File name, without extension, for a Post Action upload to your AWS S3, Cloudflare R2 or Azure storage; slashes make folders. Defaults to the transaction_ref.

postaction_s3_bucket.description: Overrides the bucket (or Azure container) configured for the Post Action.

postaction_enabled.description: 1 (default) runs the configured Post Actions; 0 skips them for this request.

meta.description: Your own external reference id for the request; it shows up in list_generated_objects.

async.description: 1 to generate asynchronously: the call returns at once and APITemplate.io calls webhook_url when done (webhook_url is then required). 0 (default) waits for the file.

webhook_url.description: URL (http or https) called when async generation finishes, with primary_url, transaction_ref and status as query parameters. Required when async is 1.

webhook_method.description: HTTP method of the webhook callback (default GET).

webhook_headers.description: Extra headers for the webhook callback, as a base64-encoded JSON object, e.g. base64 of {"workflow-api-key": "..."}.

data.description: The JSON data the template renders, keyed by its placeholder names, e.g. {"invoice_number": "INV38379", "total_amount": 82542.56}.

output.description: status, download_url of the generated file, template_id, total_pages, transaction_ref (the id for list_generated_objects) and post_actions. With async=1 only the transaction_ref comes back; the file arrives by webhook.

create_image.title: Create an image from a template
create_image.description: Generate a JPEG and/or PNG from an image template by overriding its layers by name, e.g. a text layer's text or an image layer's src. Get layer names from list_templates with with_layer_info=1. Returns download_url (JPEG) and download_url_png.

template_id.description: The template id, from list_templates or the web console (Manage Templates).

output_image_type.description: Which image files to produce: all (JPEG and PNG, default), jpegOnly or pngOnly.

expiration.description: Minutes to keep the generated file on the CDN: 0 (default) stores it permanently, 1-10080 (7 days) expires it.

cloud_storage.description: 1 (default) uploads the file to APITemplate.io's CDN; set 0 when a Post Action uploads it to your own storage.

generation_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before generation starts, e.g. to let scripts or fonts load.

resize_images.description: 1 to resize JPEG/PNG images before embedding them (use resize_max_width/height and resize_format); 0 (default) not.

resize_max_width.description: Maximum image width in pixels when resize_images is 1 (default 1000).

resize_max_height.description: Maximum image height in pixels when resize_images is 1 (default 1000).

postaction_s3_filekey.description: File name, without extension, for a Post Action upload to your AWS S3, Cloudflare R2 or Azure storage; slashes make folders. Defaults to the transaction_ref.

postaction_s3_bucket.description: Overrides the bucket (or Azure container) configured for the Post Action.

postaction_enabled.description: 1 (default) runs the configured Post Actions; 0 skips them for this request.

meta.description: Your own external reference id for the request; it shows up in list_generated_objects.

overrides.description: Layer overrides: objects with the layer name plus the properties to set, e.g. {"name": "text_1", "text": "hello world"} or {"name": "image_1", "src": "https://.../a.png"}.

output.description: status, download_url (JPEG), download_url_png, template_id, transaction_ref and post_actions.

create_pdf_from_html.title: Create a PDF from HTML
create_pdf_from_html.description: Generate a PDF from raw HTML and CSS without a saved template. The HTML may use Jinja2 placeholders such as {{name}}, filled from data. Returns the download_url. Use create_pdf for a saved template.

css.description: CSS including its <style> tag, e.g. <style>.bg{background: red}</style>.

data.description: Values for the Jinja2 placeholders in the HTML, e.g. {"name": "Ada"}.

settings.description: PDF settings: paper_size (Letter, Legal, Tabloid, Ledger, A0-A6 or custom with custom_width/custom_height such as 30mm), orientation ("1" portrait, "2" landscape), margin_top/right/bottom/left in mm, print_background ("1"/"0"), displayHeaderFooter (boolean), custom_header and custom_footer (HTML), header_font_size, rendering_engine_version ("153" default or legacy "97"), preferCSSPageSize (boolean).

expiration.description: Minutes to keep the generated file on the CDN: 0 (default) stores it permanently, 1-10080 (7 days) expires it.

output_format.description: Output format: pdf (default), html, png or jpeg. The response download_url points at the file.

filename.description: Custom file name ending in .pdf. Defaults to a UUID.

cloud_storage.description: 1 (default) uploads the file to APITemplate.io's CDN; set 0 when a Post Action uploads it to your own storage.

generation_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before generation starts, e.g. to let scripts or fonts load.

image_resample_res.description: Downsample embedded images to this DPI to shrink the PDF, e.g. 72, 96, 150, 300 or 600.

resize_images.description: 1 to resize JPEG/PNG images before embedding them (use resize_max_width/height and resize_format); 0 (default) not.

resize_max_width.description: Maximum image width in pixels when resize_images is 1 (default 1000).

resize_max_height.description: Maximum image height in pixels when resize_images is 1 (default 1000).

postaction_s3_bucket.description: Overrides the bucket (or Azure container) configured for the Post Action.

merge_pdfs.title: Merge PDFs
merge_pdfs.description: Join several PDFs, given as http(s) URLs or base64 data: URLs, into one PDF in the order given. Returns the merged file's primary_url and page count.

urls.description: PDF URLs in merge order: https://... links or data:application/pdf;base64,... URLs.

expiration.description: Minutes to keep the merged PDF on the CDN: 0 (default) permanently, or 1-43200 (30 days).

cloud_storage.description: 1 (default) uploads the file to APITemplate.io's CDN; set 0 when a Post Action uploads it to your own storage.

postaction_s3_filekey.description: File name, without extension, for a Post Action upload to your AWS S3, Cloudflare R2 or Azure storage; slashes make folders. Defaults to the transaction_ref.

postaction_s3_bucket.description: Overrides the bucket (or Azure container) configured for the Post Action.

postaction_enabled.description: 1 (default) runs the configured Post Actions; 0 skips them for this request.

meta.description: Your own external reference id for the request; it shows up in list_generated_objects.

output.description: status, primary_url of the merged PDF, total_pages and transaction_ref.
